"Yeah, why?"
"Then you'll get it — Yoda only one for me in the whole galaxy."
en.editorNote: A Star Wars opener for anyone who's into movies and shows. Even if they haven't seen it, you can just roll with 'you're my only one anyway.' Drop it between fans and the chemistry spikes instantly.
variations: The galaxy is huge, but my Force only responds to you.
Everyone else is out here hunting lightsabers — I just want to find my one and only, you.

items.sourceNote: 'Do you like bagels? Because you're bae goals' 諧音梗概念，中文另創貝果拆字版本

zh-tw.content:
「我最近超愛吃貝果。」
「為什麼突然愛吃那個？」
「因為第一個字是寶貝的貝，第二個字是果然還是你的果。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 早餐店或咖啡廳排隊時最好用，手上剛好拿著貝果就直接演一波。也適合傳早安訊息時配一張早餐照，甜度剛好不會太油。
variations: 我買了兩個貝果，一個給你，一個提醒我寶貝果然是你
別人吃貝果配咖啡，我吃貝果配想你

en.content:
"I've been really into bagels lately."
"Random. Why?"
"Because bagels are basically bae goals — and you're mine."
en.editorNote: Perfect for a coffee shop line or a good-morning text with a breakfast photo. Low effort, high cheese, and it lands best when you actually have a bagel in hand.
variations: I got two bagels — one for you, one to remind me you're bae goals.
Some people pair bagels with coffee. I pair mine with thinking about you.

items.sourceNote: 'Are you French? Because Eiffel for you' 諧音梗概念，中文改寫成艾菲爾→非你不可

zh-tw.content:
「你去過巴黎嗎？」
「沒有耶，怎麼了？」
「奇怪，那你身上怎麼會有艾菲爾鐵塔的感覺？」
「什麼意思啦？」
「艾——非你不可。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 聊旅遊、聊夢想清單的時候最順手，對方講到想去歐洲就可以接。鋪陳有兩段，講的時候記得停一下再丟最後一句，效果比一口氣講完好很多。
variations: 我的旅遊清單第一名是巴黎，第二名是你身邊
別人去巴黎看鐵塔，我看到你就已經艾非你不可

en.content:
"Have you ever been to Paris?"
"Nope, why?"
"Weird. Then why do you give off such strong Eiffel energy?"
"Meaning what?"
"Meaning I fell for you."
en.editorNote: Great when the conversation drifts to travel or bucket lists. Pause before the last line — the setup does all the work, and rushing it kills the payoff.
variations: Paris is number one on my travel list. Sitting next to you is number two.
Everyone goes to Paris for the tower. I just needed one look at you to fall.

items.sourceNote: 'grilled cheese to my tomato soup' 絕配組合概念，改寫成對話版

zh-tw.content:
「你知道我們兩個像什麼嗎？」
「像什麼？」
「烤起司三明治配番茄濃湯。」
「那是什麼意思？」
「分開吃也不錯，但湊在一起才會有人說一句：這才對嘛。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一起吃飯、討論要點什麼的時候丟出來，特別適合已經在曖昧但還沒說破的階段。重點在最後那句『這才對嘛』，語氣要輕、要像在說廢話，才不會太用力。
variations: 你一個人很好，我一個人也還行，但我們加起來才叫剛剛好
有些東西天生就要配在一起，比如濃湯跟麵包，比如你跟我

en.content:
"You know what we are?"
"What?"
"Grilled cheese and tomato soup."
"How so?"
"Both fine on their own. Together, somebody's going, 'oh, that's the one.'"
en.editorNote: Ideal over a meal or while deciding what to order, especially in that not-yet-official stage. Deliver the last line like a throwaway observation — the casualness is what sells it.
variations: You're great alone, I'm fine alone, but together we're the actual combo.
Some things are just meant to be paired. Soup and bread. You and me.

items.sourceNote: 'Is your dad a boxer? Because you're a knockout' 概念，改寫成對話並在地化

zh-tw.content:
「你爸是不是拳擊手？」
「不是啊，你在說什麼？」
「那就怪了，怎麼你一出現，我就被打得暈頭轉向。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 節奏最快的一種，三句就結束，適合聚會、班上、群組裡丟。因為完全不涉及身材外貌的具體描述，男生女生講都不會失禮。
variations: 你家是不是開武館的？不然我怎麼一看到你就守不住心防
我平常反應很快的，只有遇到你的時候完全來不及閃

en.content:
"Is your dad a boxer?"
"No? What are you talking about?"
"Strange. Then how come one look at you and I'm seeing stars?"
en.editorNote: The fastest one in the set — three lines and you're out. Works at parties or in group chats, and since it never comments on anyone's body, it stays safe no matter who's saying it.
variations: Does your family run a dojo? Because my defenses drop the second you walk in.
My reflexes are usually great. Somehow I never see you coming.

items.sourceNote: 'I'd buy you a drink, but I'd be jealous of the glass' 概念，改寫成飲料店情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「我本來想請你喝飲料。」
「那怎麼沒請？」
「因為我會嫉妒那根吸管，它可以一直陪著你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 手搖飲、便利商店、下午茶都能用，是那種丟出去對方會翻白眼但嘴角會偷偷上揚的等級。真的請了再講，效果會加倍。
variations: 這杯我請，但吸管借我嫉妒一下
我不是捨不得那杯飲料，我是羨慕它可以整個下午都在你手上

en.content:
"I was going to buy you a drink."
"So why didn't you?"
"Because I'd be jealous of the straw. It gets to hang out with you all afternoon."
en.editorNote: Works at a boba shop, a café, or a convenience store run. It's the kind of line that earns an eye roll and a smile at the same time — and it hits twice as hard if you actually buy the drink first.
variations: This one's on me. Just let me be a little jealous of the straw.
It's not the drink I mind giving away — it's that it gets to stay in your hand all day.

items.sourceNote: loyalty/reward 概念改寫成台灣手搖飲集點卡情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「你有在集點嗎？」
「有啊，怎麼了？」
「難怪，因為認識你之後，我的心就只想幫你一格一格蓋滿，蓋滿了也不換贈品，只想繼續蓋下去。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 手搖飲、便利商店集點的日常梗，台灣人一聽就懂。丟給常一起買飲料的對象最加分。
variations: 別人集點是為了換贈品，我集你是因為蓋章的過程本身就很開心
我這張卡永遠集不滿，因為對你，我根本捨不得畫上最後一格

en.content:
"Do you collect loyalty stamps?"
"Yeah, why?"
"Figures. Ever since I met you, my heart just wants to fill a whole card with your stamps — and even when it's full, I don't want the free drink, I just want to keep stamping."
en.editorNote: A punch-card joke that lands with anyone who's ever chased a free tenth drink. Best aimed at someone you grab drinks with.
variations: Most people collect stamps for the reward. I collect yours because the stamping is the fun part.
My card never fills up, because I can't bring myself to check off that last box with you.

items.sourceNote: 'special delivery' 類梗改寫成網購宅配、指定本人簽收的情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「如果心可以宅配，你希望怎麼寄？」
「不知道欸，你說呢？」
「我會選指定本人簽收，不能放管理室，也不能放超商，我要親手交到你手上。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 網購成癮世代的專屬情話，宅配、超商取貨的梗人人有感。最後那句「親手交到你手上」是重點，講的時候看著對方眼睛效果最好。
variations: 我的心已經寄出了，物流狀態顯示配送中，收件人只有你一個
別人怕包裹被偷，我只怕你不在家沒辦法親自簽收

en.content:
"If hearts could be shipped, how would you want mine sent?"
"No idea. You tell me."
"Signature required, recipient only. No front desk, no pickup locker — I'm handing it to you myself."
en.editorNote: A pickup line built for the online-shopping generation. The 'handing it to you myself' beat is the payoff — say it while holding eye contact.
variations: My heart already shipped. Tracking says out for delivery, and there's exactly one name on the label.
Other people worry their package gets stolen. I just worry you won't be home to sign for mine.

items.sourceNote: 'you're a work of art / worth figuring out' 概念改寫成沒附說明書、願意研究一輩子的對話

zh-tw.content:
「你有一個問題你知道嗎？」
「什麼問題？」
「你出現的時候沒有附說明書，害我到現在還在研究你，而且我打算研究一輩子。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 走文青可愛路線，適合那種慢熟、值得慢慢認識的對象。重點在「研究一輩子」把土味轉成長情，不會太油。
variations: 別人的東西都有說明書，只有你要我自己一頁一頁慢慢摸索，但我甘願
你這麼複雜卻沒附使用手冊，難怪我學這麼久還捨不得畢業

en.content:
"You know you've got one flaw, right?"
"What flaw?"
"You showed up without an instruction manual, so I've been figuring you out this whole time — and I plan to keep at it for the rest of my life."
en.editorNote: A softer, bookish take that suits someone worth getting to know slowly. 'Rest of my life' turns the cheese into something that actually sticks.
variations: Everything else comes with a manual. You I have to learn one page at a time — and I'm glad to.
You're this complicated with no user guide, no wonder I've studied this long and still won't graduate.

items.sourceNote: subscription/auto-renew 現代概念改寫成串流訂閱世代的情話對話

zh-tw.content:
「如果喜歡一個人要付月費，你付得下去嗎？」
「看是誰吧。」
「那我大概是那種懶得比價、直接自動續訂、還偷偷把取消鍵藏起來的人，因為對象是你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 串流訂閱世代的專屬梗，把「自動續訂」這件平常有點煩的事變成情話。適合丟給同樣被一堆訂閱綁架的對象。
variations: 別的訂閱我到期就取消，只有你這個我續了又續，還升級成年繳
我對你沒有免費試用期，一認識就直接進入不能退款的方案

en.content:
"If liking someone came with a monthly fee, could you keep paying it?"
"Depends who it is."
"Then I'm the type who won't shop around, sets it to auto-renew, and quietly hides the cancel button — because it's you."
en.editorNote: A streaming-era joke that flips the mild annoyance of auto-renewal into a compliment. Perfect for someone equally buried in subscriptions.
variations: Every other subscription I cancel the second it lapses. Yours I keep renewing — and upgraded to annual.
There was never a free trial with you. I went straight to the no-refund plan.

items.sourceNote: 'you're stuck in my head / on my mind' 概念改寫成便利貼貼滿腦袋的情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「你桌上會貼便利貼嗎？」
「會啊，提醒自己不要忘記事情。」
「那你知道嗎，我腦袋現在貼滿便利貼，每一張上面寫的都是你，而且我一張都捨不得撕。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 上班族、學生都有感的日常小物梗。畫面感很強，「一張都捨不得撕」把土味收得剛剛好。
variations: 我的待辦清單只剩一件事，用最大張的便利貼寫著你的名字
別人貼便利貼是怕忘記，我貼你是因為根本停不下來想你

en.content:
"Do you keep sticky notes on your desk?"
"Yeah, so I don't forget stuff."
"Well, my head is covered in them right now — and every single one just says you. I can't bring myself to peel a single one off."
en.editorNote: A desk-life detail that clicks with students and office folks alike. Very visual, and 'can't peel a single one off' keeps the cheese in check.
variations: My whole to-do list is down to one item, written on the biggest sticky note: your name.
People use sticky notes so they won't forget. I stick yours up because I can't stop thinking about you.

items.sourceNote: parking spot 主題改寫成「心裡預留 VIP 車位」的日常對話

zh-tw.content:
「你開車最怕遇到什麼？」
「找不到停車位吧，超崩潰。」
「那你放心，別的地方我不敢保證，但我心裡那個 VIP 車位，永遠幫你留著，還不用抽號碼牌。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 有車族、通勤族超有感，把「找不到車位」這個日常痛點翻成情話。適合傳給每天為停車煩惱的對象。
variations: 路邊停車位我可以繞十圈都找不到，但要停進你心裡，我一次就到位
別人停車要計時收費，你這個車位我停一輩子都免費

en.content:
"What's your biggest fear when you drive?"
"Not finding a parking spot, honestly. It's the worst."
"Well, I can't promise anything else, but the VIP spot in my heart? It's reserved for you — no ticket, no waiting."
en.editorNote: Lands hard with drivers and commuters — flips the everyday pain of parking into a compliment. Great for someone who's always circling the block.
variations: I'll circle a lot ten times and still not find a spot, but parking in your heart? Nailed it first try.
Every other spot charges by the hour. Yours I get to keep for life, free of charge.

items.sourceNote: QR code / scan 概念改寫成「一看到你就想掃、連結都通往你」的對話

zh-tw.content:
「你身上是不是有 QR code？」
「哪有，你在說什麼？」
「不然我怎麼一看到你，整個人就自動靠過去想掃一下，而且掃出來的連結，每一條都通往你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 數位世代的日常梗，把「掃碼」這個每天在做的動作變成情話。畫面感強，適合傳給同樣手機不離身的對象。
variations: 別的 QR code 掃完就關掉，只有你這條，我想一直重新整理
我根本不用對焦，一看到你就自動掃描成功，還直接存進最愛

en.content:
"Do you have a QR code on you somewhere?"
"No? What are you talking about?"
"Then why do I lean in to scan you the second I see you — and every link it opens just leads back to you?"
en.editorNote: A digital-native joke that turns the everyday act of scanning into a line. Very visual — perfect for someone as glued to their phone as you are.
variations: Every other QR code I close the second it loads. Yours I just keep refreshing.
I don't even need to focus — one look at you and the scan succeeds, straight to favorites.

items.sourceNote: self-checkout / barcode 概念改寫成「想把你嗶回家但你無價」的對話

zh-tw.content:
「你有用過自助結帳嗎？」
「有啊，超方便的。」
「難怪，因為我剛剛就想把你『嗶』一聲帶回家，結果發現你根本刷不出價格——原來你是無價的。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 超市、超商日常梗，把「自助結帳嗶一下」的動作變情話，最後用「無價」把土味收得剛剛好。適合輕鬆調情、不會太油。
variations: 別的東西嗶完要付錢，只有你，我想直接抱著走出感應門
我拿著你走到收銀台，機器說『此商品無法掃描，因為它是我的』

en.content:
"Ever used self-checkout?"
"Yeah, it's so convenient."
"Figures — because I just tried to beep you and take you home, but you wouldn't scan. Turns out you're priceless."
en.editorNote: A grocery-run joke that turns the self-checkout beep into a line, landing softly on 'priceless.' Playful without laying it on too thick.
variations: Everything else I pay for after the beep. You? I just want to walk you straight through the sensor gate.
I brought you to the register and the machine said 'item won't scan — because it's mine.'

items.sourceNote: home / anywhere-you-are angle

zh-tw.content:
「你到家了嗎？」
「還沒欸，怎麼了？」
「那你慢慢走沒關係，反正只要有你在，哪裡對我來說都算家了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 送對方回家、道晚安的那段路上丟出去剛剛好
variations: 沒你的地方，再舒服我也覺得不算家
我最近才發現，家不是一個地址，是有你在的那個方向

en.content:
"Did you make it home yet?"
"Not yet, why?"
"Take your time—honestly, anywhere you are already feels like home to me."
en.editorNote: Perfect for the walk home or the goodnight text
variations: Home stopped being an address the day it turned into wherever you are.
No matter how comfy a place is, it doesn't count as home if you're not in it.

items.sourceNote: burger pun 飽/抱; en adapted to 'snack' slang

zh-tw.content:
「你怎麼又點漢堡了？」
「因為別人吃漢堡是為了『飽』，我吃漢堡是為了『抱』你啊。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 速食店約會的神救援，諧音一出對方通常會翻白眼但嘴角上揚
variations: 我點雙層的，因為想抱你的力氣要備足一點
薯條可以分你，但這個抱字我只留給你

en.content:
"Why'd you order another burger?"
"Everyone else orders one to get full—I just needed an excuse to sit here and tell you you're a whole snack."
en.editorNote: A fast-food-date rescue line; leans on 'snack' as a compliment
variations: I went for the double—takes extra strength to handle someone this cute.
You can have my fries, but I'm keeping the last bite as a reason to see you again.

items.sourceNote: rainbow-on-smile angle, distinct from umbrella/rain items

zh-tw.content:
「剛剛有下雨嗎？」
「沒有啊，怎麼了？」
「奇怪，那你臉上怎麼會有一道彩虹——原來是你笑起來的時候。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 趁對方剛笑出來那一秒丟，殺傷力最強
variations: 沒下雨哪來的彩虹，八成是你笑的時候偷偷掛上去的
我以為要下過雨才有彩虹，結果你笑一下就有了

en.content:
"Did it just rain?"
"No? Why?"
"Weird—then how does a rainbow show up on your face every single time you smile?"
en.editorNote: Drop it the second they start smiling for maximum effect
variations: No rain, but there's a rainbow—must've snuck in when you laughed.
I thought you needed a storm first to get a rainbow. Turns out you just need to smile.

items.sourceNote: power bank / charging angle, distinct from wifi-signal items

zh-tw.content:
「你是不是行動電源？」
「蛤？為什麼這樣問？」
「因為我一靠近你，就覺得自己瞬間充飽電，一整天都不會累。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 忙了一天終於見到面時用，帶點撒嬌
variations: 別人充電要插線，我只要看到你就滿格了
難怪我最近都不用充電，原來電力來源是你

en.content:
"Are you a power bank?"
"Uh, why?"
"Because the second I get near you I hit a hundred percent and stay charged all day."
en.editorNote: Use it when you finally meet up after a long day—a little clingy in a good way
variations: Everyone else needs a cable to charge. I just need to see you.
No wonder I haven't plugged in lately—turns out you're my power source.

items.sourceNote: hot weather / cooling-off 主題改寫成「電風扇搖頭」的台式夏日情境，避開既有的冷氣壞掉梗

zh-tw.content:
「你家電風扇會搖頭嗎？」
「會啊，不然吹不到。」
「那你有沒有發現，我家那台搖來搖去，最後永遠停在你坐的那個方向。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 夏天在家一起耍廢、開電扇看劇的時候丟出來剛剛好，畫面感十足又不會太油。
variations: 我家電扇壞掉了，因為它只想吹你，不想轉別的方向
別人開電扇是為了涼快，我開是想看它跟我一樣一直看向你

en.content:
"Does your fan oscillate?"
"Yeah, otherwise it only hits one spot."
"Funny — mine swings back and forth all day and somehow always stops facing wherever you're sitting."
en.editorNote: Perfect for a lazy summer afternoon with the fan on and a show playing. Visual, warm, and not too thick.
variations: I think my fan is broken. It refuses to point anywhere except at you.
Everyone else turns on a fan to cool down. I turn mine on to watch it stare at you too.

items.sourceNote: summer sweet-treat pun 改寫成台式剉冰／煉乳情境；en 版改用 snow cone 保留同樣笑點

zh-tw.content:
「你吃剉冰會淋煉乳嗎？」
「一定要啊，不然不夠甜。」
「那你這碗可以省下來了，因為只要你坐在對面，我這碗自己就甜起來了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 夏天約吃冰的時候現場發揮，最後一句要笑著講，太認真反而尷尬。
variations: 老闆說配料最多選四種，我說不用了，坐我對面這個就夠甜
冰會融，煉乳會沒，只有你這種甜是不會退冰的

en.content:
"Do you put syrup on your snow cone?"
"Obviously. It's not sweet enough otherwise."
"You can skip it today — mine gets sweet all by itself the second you sit across from me."
en.editorNote: Best used live at the ice-cream window. Deliver it grinning; playing it straight makes it awkward.
variations: The guy said pick four toppings. I said no thanks, the person across from me covers it.
Ice melts and syrup runs out. Somehow the sweet part of you never does.

items.sourceNote: summer nuisance angle 改寫成「蚊子在耳邊繞」的自嘲式情話

zh-tw.content:
「夏天你最受不了什麼？」
「蚊子吧，整晚在耳邊嗡嗡叫。」
「那我可能比蚊子還煩，因為我也整晚在你耳邊——差別是我不吸血，我只是捨不得停止跟你講話。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 深夜聊天聊到快睡著時最適合，自嘲的口吻讓土味變得可愛而不油。
variations: 蚊子叮你是因為你血甜，我靠過去是因為你整個人都甜
我幫你打蚊子不是因為勇敢，是因為那個位置我想自己站

en.content:
"What's the worst part of summer for you?"
"Mosquitoes. Buzzing in my ear all night."
"Then I might be worse than a mosquito — I'm also in your ear all night. I just don't bite, I only refuse to stop talking to you."
en.editorNote: Ideal for a late-night chat that's dragging toward sleep. The self-deprecating framing keeps it cute instead of greasy.
variations: Mosquitoes go for you because you're sweet. I'm just here for the same reason.
I didn't swat that one to be brave. I just wanted that spot next to you for myself.

items.sourceNote: 台灣統一發票對獎日常改寫；en 版改成 scratch ticket 保留「唯一中過的獎是你」的核心

zh-tw.content:
「這期發票你對了嗎？」
「對了啊，一張都沒中。」
「我也是欸。不過想想也還好，反正我這輩子中過最大的那個獎，早就站在我旁邊了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 雙月對獎季的限定土味，台灣人一聽就懂。適合在超商排隊、掃發票的時候順口丟出來。
variations: 別人期待兌獎日，我每天期待的是你回訊息那一下
我不太會中獎，唯一一次手氣好，就是那天遇到你

en.content:
"Did you check your scratch ticket?"
"Yeah. Nothing, as usual."
"Same here. Doesn't bother me though — the only thing I've ever actually won is already standing right next to me."
en.editorNote: A convenience-store-line kind of joke. Casual, low-stakes, and it lands without any setup.
variations: Other people wait for the drawing. I just wait for you to text back.
I never win anything. The one time my luck held was the day I met you.

items.sourceNote: summer electricity-bill 梗改寫成「心裡有東西沒關機」的情話

zh-tw.content:
「這個月電費怎麼爆表？」
「不知道欸，我東西都有關。」
「那應該是我這邊的問題，因為我心裡有個程式一直開著沒關機，跑的內容全部都是你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 夏天收到電費單那天的最佳自救台詞，抱怨變情話，殺傷力比想像中大。
variations: 我家最耗電的不是冷氣，是想你這件事，而且它沒有省電模式
帳單這麼高很合理，畢竟有個人在我腦裡住了整個夏天還不繳房租

en.content:
"How is the power bill this high?"
"No idea, I turned everything off."
"Might be on my end — there's one thing in my head that's been running nonstop all month, and it's all you."
en.editorNote: Your best move on the day the summer bill arrives. Turning a complaint into a line hits harder than it should.
variations: The AC isn't what's draining me. Thinking about you is, and it has no eco mode.
Makes sense the bill is huge — someone's been living rent-free in my head all summer.

items.sourceNote: 改寫自 'you autocomplete me' 諧音梗，換成手機輸入法情境

zh-tw.content:
「你知道我手機為什麼跑那麼慢嗎？」
「當機了逆？」
「不是，是我輸入法的預測字壞掉了——不管我打什麼開頭，第一個跳出來的永遠是你的名字。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 低頭族專用，傳訊息時附上截圖效果加倍
variations: 我把常用詞全部清空重設過一次，結果第一個自己跳回來的還是你

en.content:
"Know why my phone's been so slow lately?"
"Storage full?"
"Nope — my autocomplete's broken. No matter what I start typing, the first word it suggests is your name."
en.editorNote: Perfect over text — send a screenshot for double the effect
variations: I wiped my whole keyboard dictionary to fix it, and you were still the first word it guessed.

items.sourceNote: 改寫自 'is your name Chapstick? because you're da balm' 護唇膏梗

zh-tw.content:
「你怎麼隨身帶護唇膏啊？」
「習慣啊，嘴巴容易乾。」
「原來如此，那我也該備一條了——因為每次看到你我都笑到嘴角快裂開，得先護一下，等等笑破。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 自嘲式土味，適合已經有點熟的曖昧對象
variations: 我最近唇膏用超快，都是被你笑掉的

en.content:
"Why do you always carry lip balm?"
"Habit — my lips get dry."
"Makes sense, I should start too — every time I see you I grin so hard my cheeks are about to crack."
en.editorNote: Self-deprecating cheese — best for someone you're already comfy with
variations: I've been going through lip balm way too fast lately, and it's entirely your smile's fault.

items.sourceNote: 改寫自 Wall/Eye/Knee 英文諧音『我也是』的雙語梗

zh-tw.content:
「我喜歡你。」
「Wall、Eye、Knee。」
「蛤？你在念什麼？」
「牆壁、眼睛、膝蓋——連起來快念一次，就是我想回你的那句：我也是。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 念給對方聽現場效果最好，反應絕對是笑出來
variations: 下次換你出招：Egg、Roll、Sand——講快一點，其實是『我囉你想』

en.content:
"I like you."
"Wall. Eye. Knee."
"...what?"
"Say them fast enough — 'wall-eye-knee' sounds just like 'wǒ yě shì', which is Mandarin for 'me too.' I've been practicing that answer for a while."
en.editorNote: Land it out loud, not in text — the delivery is the whole joke
variations: Your turn to reply: 'Sh-out.' Say it quick and it's basically 'I would' in Chinese too.

items.sourceNote: 夏季情境原創，融化梗

zh-tw.content:
「這天氣熱到快融化了欸。」
「對啊，走沒幾步就滿身汗。」
「難怪，我剛剛才想通——原來會融化的不只有冰，還有我每次對到你眼睛的那一秒。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 盛夏限定，走在路上隨口就能講的甜度剛好
variations: 別人靠冷氣續命，我靠你笑一下就整個涼下來

en.content:
"It's so hot I'm literally melting."
"Same, I'm drenched after like ten steps."
"Figures — turns out ice isn't the only thing that melts. So do I, every second I catch your eyes."
en.editorNote: Summer-only line, casual enough to drop while walking around
variations: Everyone else survives on AC — I just need you to smile once and I cool right down.

items.sourceNote: 改寫自 latte/steamed into my heart 拿鐵梗

zh-tw.content:
「你點什麼？」
「熱拿鐵。」
「難怪我剛剛心跳這麼快——原來是被你這杯蒸出來的熱氣，整個燙進心裡了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 在咖啡廳排隊或等外帶時最好用，順著對方的點單接就行
variations: 我這杯不用加糖了，站你旁邊已經夠甜

en.content:
"What are you getting?"
"A hot latte."
"No wonder my heart's been racing — turns out you steamed your way straight into it."
en.editorNote: Perfect while waiting in line at a café — just riff off their order
variations: I'll skip the sugar in mine — standing next to you is already sweet enough.

items.sourceNote: 改寫自 'are you cheese? because I melt for you' 起司融化梗

zh-tw.content:
「這披薩牽絲牽超長欸。」
「對啊，起司放好多。」
「我懂那種感覺，因為我看到你的時候，整個人也是這樣——軟掉、融化、還捨不得斷。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 吃飯約會限定，邊分食邊講最自然
variations: 別人融化要加熱，我只要你走過來

en.content:
"This pizza's got the longest cheese pull ever."
"Right? They loaded it on."
"I get it though — that's exactly what happens to me when I see you. I go soft, I melt, and I really don't want it to end."
en.editorNote: Dinner-date only — best delivered mid-bite while sharing a plate
variations: Everyone else needs heat to melt — I just need you to walk over.

items.sourceNote: 改寫自 'are you a loyalty card? because I'd keep coming back' 集點卡回頭客梗

zh-tw.content:
「你這家集點卡快集滿了欸。」
「對啊，我常來。」
「那我懂你為什麼常來了——因為我也是，只要你在，我這個回頭客怎麼樣都戒不掉。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合常去同一家店遇到的曖昧對象，熟客感加分
variations: 我這張卡永遠集不滿，因為看到你我又想多待一下

en.content:
"Your loyalty card's almost full."
"Yeah, I come here a lot."
"Now I get why — same here. As long as you're around, I can't quit being a regular."
en.editorNote: For the crush you keep running into at the same spot — leans into the regular-customer vibe
variations: My card never fills up, because one look at you and I want to stay a little longer.

items.sourceNote: 改寫自胖了『分量越來越重』諧音梗

zh-tw.content:
「我最近是不是胖了？」
「沒有啊，怎麼突然這樣問？」
「因為我最近覺得你越來越重——重的是你在我心裡的分量，一天比一天壓得我睡不著。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方擔心身材時反手一撩，化解尷尬又順勢告白
variations: 你放心，你唯一變重的地方是我心裡那一格

en.content:
"Do you think I've gained weight lately?"
"No? Why the sudden question?"
"Because you have been feeling heavier to me — the weight you carry in my heart, and it grows a little more every single day."
en.editorNote: A quick pivot when they're fretting about their body — defuses it and slips in a confession
variations: Relax — the only place you've gotten heavier is the spot you take up in my heart.

items.sourceNote: 七夕情境原創，星巴克/手搖店續杯梗

zh-tw.content:
「你這杯喝完要續嗎？」
「不用了，喝一杯就夠。」
「差別在這裡——飲料我一杯就飽，但你這個人，我可以續一輩子都不嫌多。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 手搖或咖啡約會收尾時講，甜度收在剛剛好的位置
variations: 我對飲料很節制，唯獨對你完全不想設上限

en.content:
"Want a refill on that?"
"Nah, one cup's plenty."
"That's the difference — one drink and I'm done, but you? I could refill on you for a lifetime and never get sick of it."
en.editorNote: A closer for a boba or coffee date — keeps the sweetness right at the edge without tipping over
variations: I've got great self-control with drinks — you're the one thing I refuse to put a limit on.

items.sourceNote: 問答式撩語靈感，安全帶情境原創

zh-tw.content:
「上我的車記得繫安全帶。」
「你開很快喔？」
「不是，是怕你太可愛，我一分心緊急煞車，捨不得你撞到。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 開車載對方時講最自然，順便關心一下更加分
variations: 繫好安全帶，這趟路我想穩穩地把你載到未來

en.content:
"Buckle up when you're in my car."
"Do you drive fast or something?"
"No — I'm just scared that you're so cute I'll get distracted and slam the brakes, and I can't stand the thought of you getting hurt."
en.editorNote: Feels natural when you're giving them a ride, and the concern earns you bonus points
variations: Buckle up — I plan to drive you all the way to our future, nice and steady.

items.sourceNote: 字典/例句梗原創發想

zh-tw.content:
「如果我出一本字典，你猜『幸福』那頁會寫什麼？」
「寫什麼？」
「例句就一句——『自從遇見你』。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 文青系的撩法，適合喜歡文字的對象，講完記得笑一下化解尷尬
variations: 我查了整本字典，還是找不到一個詞能形容你有多好

en.content:
"If I wrote a dictionary, guess what the page for 'happiness' would say?"
"What?"
"The example sentence would just be: 'ever since I met you.'"
en.editorNote: A bookish approach for someone who loves words — flash a grin afterward to cut the cringe
variations: I went through the whole dictionary and still couldn't find a word good enough for you.

items.sourceNote: 藏寶圖梗改寫，X marks the spot 概念

zh-tw.content:
「我覺得你很像一張藏寶圖。」
「哪裡像？」
「別人挖到的是黃金，我挖到的是想守一輩子的寶。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 帶點冒險感的撩法，講完可以順勢說『那我可以繼續挖嗎』
variations: 尋寶尋了那麼久，原來終點的那個 X 就是你

en.content:
"You know, you're a lot like a treasure map."
"How so?"
"Everyone else digs up gold — I dug up the one treasure I want to keep for life."
en.editorNote: An adventurous angle; follow it with 'so, mind if I keep digging?' to keep it playful
variations: After all that searching, turns out the X on the map was you the whole time.

items.sourceNote: 違停/罰單梗原創

zh-tw.content:
「不好意思，我要開你一張罰單。」
「我又沒犯法？」
「有，你的心違停在我這，還一停就不打算走了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合帶點壞壞氣場的人，語氣越正經笑點越強
variations: 違停就算了，你連我的注意力都一起偷走，這條要加罰

en.content:
"Excuse me, I'm going to have to write you a ticket."
"For what? I didn't break any laws."
"You did — your heart's parked illegally in mine, and it clearly has no plans to leave."
en.editorNote: Works best with a little bad-boy energy; the straighter your face, the better it lands
variations: Illegal parking's one thing, but you stole my attention too — that's a separate fine.

items.sourceNote: 過敏反應梗原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「你身上是不是有什麼過敏原？」
「應該沒有吧？」
「奇怪，那為什麼我一靠近你就臉紅心跳，八成是我對你嚴重過敏了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 反差萌路線，把心動說成過敏，講完自己先笑最加分
variations: 醫生說我對你的症狀無藥可醫，只能一輩子近距離觀察

en.content:
"Are you carrying some kind of allergen on you?"
"I don't think so, why?"
"Weird — because every time I get close I go red and my heart races. I must be seriously allergic to you."
en.editorNote: A cute reframe that turns a crush into an 'allergy' — laughing at your own line first seals it
variations: The doctor says there's no cure for my reaction to you — I'll just have to keep you close for observation.

items.sourceNote: 颱風假情境梗原創

zh-tw.content:
「明天到底放不放颱風假啊？」
「還在等公布，你怎麼一直看手機？」
「我這邊已經確定停班停課了，滿腦子都是你，什麼事都做不了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 颱風季限定，群組裡大家在等公布時丟這句最有效
variations: 氣象預報說暴風圈還在外圍，可是我這邊已經正面登陸了
別人放假是因為風太大，我放假是因為你太可愛

en.content:
"Think they'll call off work tomorrow for the storm?"
"Still waiting on the announcement. Why do you keep checking your phone?"
"Mine's already cancelled. You're taking up my whole head — I can't get anything done."
en.editorNote: Storm-season line; perfect to drop in the group chat while everyone waits on the announcement
variations: The forecast says the storm's still offshore. Mine already made landfall.
Everyone else gets the day off because of the wind. I get it because of you.

items.sourceNote: 延長保固梗原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「我想幫我的心辦延長保固。」
「哪有這種東西？」
「有啊，只要你點頭留下來，它就自動終身保固，永遠不會故障。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合已經有點曖昧、想再往前推一步的時候說
variations: 別人的保固只有一年，我對你直接寫終身，還不用附發票
我這顆心唯一的保固條款是：只要你在，它就不會壞

en.content:
"I'd like to buy an extended warranty on my heart."
"That's not a real thing."
"It is — the second you agree to stay, it's covered for life and it never breaks down."
en.editorNote: Good for when things are already warm and you want to nudge it one step further
variations: Most warranties run a year. The one I wrote for you says lifetime, no receipt needed.
There's exactly one clause on my heart's warranty: as long as you're around, it doesn't break.

items.sourceNote: 健檢報告梗原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「我健檢報告出來了。」
「還好嗎？有沒有什麼問題？」
「心電圖上有一段特別亂，我對了一下時間，剛好是你傳訊息給我那一刻。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 把數據當證據，講的時候越像在念報告越好笑
variations: 報告上每一欄都寫正常，只有心跳那欄備註：遇到某人時除外
我把那張圖存起來了，因為那是我心動最誠實的一次紀錄

en.content:
"My checkup results came back today."
"Everything okay? Anything wrong?"
"There's one messy stretch on the EKG. I checked the timestamp — it's the exact minute your text came in."
en.editorNote: Data as evidence; the flatter and more clinical you read it, the funnier it lands
variations: Every line on the report says normal. The heart rate one has a footnote: 'except around a certain person.'
I saved that printout, because it's the most honest record I have of you getting to me.

items.sourceNote: 湊免運梗原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「我購物車差一點點就免運了。」
「那就隨便加個小東西啊。」
「不用，我知道少了什麼——把你加進來，我整個人生就免運，還自動升級成隔日到貨。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一起逛網拍或幫對方湊單的時候順口丟出來
variations: 別人湊免運是為了省那幾十塊，我湊你是因為只有你值得我按下結帳
我的購物車放很久都沒清空，因為我一直在等你說也想要一份

en.content:
"My cart's like three bucks short of free shipping."
"Just toss in something small."
"No need, I know what's missing — add you and my whole life ships free, upgraded to next-day."
en.editorNote: Easy to drop while you're shopping online together or helping them hit the threshold
variations: People add junk to hit free shipping. I'd add you, because you're the only reason checkout feels worth it.
My cart's been sitting there for weeks. I'm just waiting for you to say you want one too.

items.sourceNote: 搶票候補梗原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「票搶到了嗎？」
「候補三千多號，沒希望了啦。」
「沒關係，反正我在候補的那個位子只有一個名額，而且早就確定是你了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 搶票季通用，安慰對方的同時順便告白
variations: 別人熬夜是為了搶票，我熬夜是為了等你回訊息，而且從來不用抽籤
我最想去的那一場，其實不用買票，只要你願意坐我旁邊

en.content:
"Did you get tickets?"
"Waitlist number three thousand something. It's hopeless."
"That's fine. The waitlist I'm on has exactly one spot, and it's had your name on it for a while."
en.editorNote: Presale-season line that comforts them and confesses at the same time
variations: Other people stay up all night for a presale. I stay up waiting on your text — no lottery involved.
The show I actually want to see doesn't need a ticket. It just needs you in the seat next to mine.

items.sourceNote: 抽卡「歪掉」情境原創，有問有答式撩語結構

zh-tw.content:
「你這次抽到想要的了嗎？」
「沒有，又歪掉了。」
「我也歪過一次——本來只想抽個朋友，結果整顆心歪到你身上，而且我完全不想重抽。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一起玩手遊或會聊遊戲的對象，對方哀怨的時候接這句最順
variations: 別人歪掉會心痛，只有我歪到你身上覺得是這輩子最賺的一次
我不需要保底，因為第一次遇到你就已經是限定款了

en.content:
"Did you finally get the one you wanted?"
"Nope. Went off-target again."
"Mine went off-target once too — I was aiming for 'just friends' and landed on you. I'm not rerolling."
en.editorNote: For someone you game with; drop it right after they finish complaining about their luck
variations: Everyone else groans when a pull goes wrong. Mine went wrong straight into you, and it's the best luck I've ever had.
I don't need a guaranteed drop — you showed up on the first try and you're already the rare one.

items.sourceNote: 定存利息梗原創問答，銀行情境改寫

zh-tw.content:
「這筆錢你要放定存嗎？」
「利息那麼低，放著也一樣。」
「那你放我這裡好了，我這邊利息全市場最高，唯一的條款是不能提前解約。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊到錢、聊到未來規劃的時候順勢丟出來，務實派會很吃這一套
variations: 我沒什麼投資天分，唯一一筆長期持有就是你
別人算利率算到失眠，我只算過一件事：跟你在一起怎麼算都划算

en.content:
"Are you putting that money in a savings account?"
"The rate's so low it barely matters."
"Then park it with me. My rate beats the whole market — one clause only: no early withdrawal."
en.editorNote: Slip it in when the conversation turns to money or long-term plans; the practical types eat this up
variations: I'm terrible at investing. You're the only thing I've ever held long-term.
Other people lose sleep comparing rates. I only ran one number, and being with you comes out ahead every time.

items.sourceNote: 紅燈秒數情境原創

zh-tw.content:
「這個紅燈怎麼那麼久啊？」
「還有九十八秒。」
「太好了，那我就有九十八秒可以名正言順地看著你，還不用找藉口。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 一起等紅燈或等車的時候講，語氣輕鬆一點才不會太用力
variations: 別人抱怨這個路口太慢，我倒希望它今天再壞一次
我從來不搶綠燈，因為你在的地方我一點都不想往前走

en.content:
"Why is this light taking forever?"
"Ninety-eight seconds to go."
"Perfect. That's ninety-eight seconds I get to look at you, fully justified, no excuse required."
en.editorNote: For waiting at a crosswalk or a bus stop together; keep it light so it doesn't land too hard
variations: Everyone complains this intersection is slow. I'm hoping it glitches again today.
I never race the green, because I'm in no hurry to move on from wherever you are.

items.sourceNote: 除濕機情境原創問答，改寫自生活家電式撩語結構

zh-tw.content:
「你家除濕機一天抽多少水？」
「三公升吧，最近很有感。」
「那借我用一下好了。我房間濕度都降到四十了，可是只要你坐過來，我手心還是照樣冒汗。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 夏天在對方家裡或一起買家電時順口丟出來，語氣要像在抱怨機器不夠力才自然
variations: 這台機器能把整個夏天抽乾，唯一抽不掉的，是我看到你就緊張的那一點濕度
水箱我天天倒，只有你走過來的時候，那個數字才會偷偷往上跳

en.content:
"How much water does your dehumidifier pull in a day?"
"About three liters. You can really tell lately."
"Can I borrow it? My room's already down to forty percent and my palms still go damp the second you sit next to me."
en.editorNote: For a muggy day at their place or while shopping for appliances; deliver it like you're complaining about the machine
variations: That thing can dry out an entire summer. The one bit of moisture it can't touch is how nervous you make me.
I empty the tank every night. The number only creeps back up when you walk over.

items.sourceNote: 演唱會安可情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「你剛剛安可喊得超大聲欸。」
「難得來一次，當然要喊啊。」
「我懂。因為我每次跟你說完再見，走到轉角都還想再喊一次。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 散場路上或聊到演唱會的時候講，尾音放輕比較不油
variations: 別人的安可是想再聽一首，我的安可是想再多看你三十秒
這場我最喜歡的不是壓軸，是散場時你回頭找我的那一眼

en.content:
"You were yelling for an encore louder than anyone back there."
"I only get to do this once a year, so yeah."
"I get it. Every time I say goodbye to you, I get to the corner and still want to shout for one more."
en.editorNote: Best on the walk out of a venue, or any time concerts come up; keep the last line quiet
variations: Everyone else wants one more song. I want thirty more seconds of looking at you.
My favorite part wasn't the headliner. It was you turning around to find me on the way out.

items.sourceNote: 二手拍賣面交梗原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「這個賣家約捷運站面交欸。」
「那你要去嗎？」
「去啊。不過我這輩子最重要的一次面交早就完成了——那天我把整顆心當面交給你，還忘記跟你收運費。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 一起滑二手拍賣、或對方要出門面交時最順，講完可以裝作在算運費
variations: 別人面交怕遇到怪人，我那次只怕自己沒把話講完就跑掉
我賣場上什麼都能議價，只有喜歡你這件事是定價，不二價

en.content:
"This seller wants to meet at the station to hand it over."
"Are you going?"
"Sure. But the most important handoff of my life already happened — the day I gave you my whole heart in person and forgot to charge you for shipping."
en.editorNote: For scrolling resale listings together or when they're heading out to meet a seller; pretend to do the math afterward
variations: Most people worry about meeting a weirdo. I only worried about chickening out before I finished the sentence.
Everything in my shop is negotiable. Liking you is the one fixed price.

items.sourceNote: 語言學習 App 連續紀錄情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「我西班牙文連續兩百天沒斷欸。」
「厲害，都不會忘記喔？」
「不會啊。不過我有一條更長的——想你這件事，早就超過兩百天，一天都沒請過假。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合會聊自我進修、打卡習慣的對象，語氣越像在炫耀紀錄越好笑
variations: 別的紀錄斷了都能重來，只有你那條我一天都不敢漏
我學了那麼多語言，最想學會的還是怎麼把喜歡你講得剛剛好

en.content:
"I'm two hundred days into my Spanish streak."
"Impressive. You never forget?"
"Never. But I've got a longer one running — thinking about you passed two hundred days ages ago, and I've never taken a day off."
en.editorNote: For someone who tracks habits or streaks; play it like you're bragging about the number
variations: Any other streak I could just start over. That one I don't even take a day off from.
I've picked up a few languages and I still can't say I like you in exactly the right way.

items.sourceNote: 立秋「咬秋」啃西瓜習俗情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「今天立秋，老一輩說要啃一口西瓜。」
「啃了會怎樣？」
「叫做咬秋，據說能把夏天的尾巴咬住。我剛剛試了，夏天沒咬住——倒是把喜歡你這件事咬得死緊。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 立秋前後或一起吃西瓜的時候講，最後一句放慢講比較有味道
variations: 夏天再怎麼會跑，我只想留住有你的那幾天
別人咬秋是怕熱走太快，我是怕你走太快

en.content:
"It's the first day of autumn on the old calendar. You're supposed to bite into a watermelon."
"And that does what, exactly?"
"It's called biting off summer — it holds the tail end of it in place. I tried it just now. Didn't catch summer at all. Just bit down really hard on liking you."
en.editorNote: For the first week of August, or any time you're sharing watermelon; slow down on the last line
variations: Summer can run off all it wants. I only want to keep the days that had you in them.
Everyone else is trying to hold on to the heat. I'm trying to hold on to you.

items.sourceNote: 交通卡自動加值情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「我卡片又餘額不足，在閘門前面卡住超尷尬。」
「你不會開自動加值喔？」
「有開啊。不過我只有一張從來沒被擋下來過——喜歡你那張，早就設成無上限自動加值了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 一起搭捷運、對方卡片嗶不過去的當下接最自然，講完可以順手幫他刷
variations: 別的卡刷完會扣，只有你這張越刷餘額越多
我這輩子最捨得儲值的地方，就是跟你有關的每一件事

en.content:
"My transit card got declined at the gate again. In front of everyone."
"Why don't you just turn on auto-reload?"
"I did. There's exactly one card of mine that's never been declined — the one for liking you. That's set to reload forever, no limit."
en.editorNote: Use it the second their card gets rejected at the turnstile, then tap them through with yours
variations: Every other card goes down when you use it. Yours somehow goes up.
I'm stingy about most things. Anything with you attached to it, I'll top up all day.

items.sourceNote: 2026 社群流行語「留友看」情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「你截這張圖幹嘛？」
「留友看啊。」
「那我手機裡那個資料夾比較慘——裡面全是你講過的話，一句都沒留給朋友看過。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方在截圖或整理相簿時講，語氣要像不小心承認了什麼
variations: 別人截圖是怕忘記，我截圖是怕自己太快習慣你對我好
那個資料夾我連名字都不敢取，怕點開會笑出來

en.content:
"Why did you screenshot that?"
"Saving it for the group chat."
"Mine's worse, then. I've got a whole folder of things you've said, and not one of them has ever made it to a group chat."
en.editorNote: Best while they're screenshotting something; deliver it like you didn't mean to admit it
variations: Most people screenshot so they don't forget. I do it so I don't get used to you being nice to me.
I haven't even named that folder. I'd laugh at myself every time I opened it.

items.sourceNote: 暑假倒數、暑假作業情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「暑假只剩三個禮拜，有夠可怕。」
「作業寫完了嗎？」
「一題都還沒。不過有一份我第一天就寫完了——那一格寫著『這個夏天最想見到的人』，我填完就再也沒改過。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合學生或聊到學生時代回憶的人，八月底講最有共鳴
variations: 暑假作業可以拖到最後一天，只有想見你這件事我從來不拖
開學我什麼都沒準備好，只準備好每天在走廊上等你經過

en.content:
"Three weeks of summer left. Terrifying."
"Have you started any of the assignments?"
"Not one. Except there's one I filled out on day one — the line that said 'person you most want to see this summer.' Never changed my answer."
en.editorNote: For students, or anyone reminiscing about school; hits hardest in late August
variations: Homework I'll put off until the last night. Wanting to see you I've never once put off.
I'm not ready for anything this semester except waiting in the hallway for you to walk past.

items.sourceNote: 2026 中元普渡（農曆七月 8/13 起）供品情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「公司普渡叫我去採買，你說要買什麼？」
「飲料多買幾箱吧，大家都會拿。」
「好。不過我這輩子最誠心的一次擺供品，桌上只有一樣東西——一顆從遇見你那天就沒收回來的心，而且我天天記得換新的。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 農曆七月前後、一起去大賣場搬供品時最順，語氣要像在認真對帳單
variations: 普渡是拜給看不見的，我喜歡你也是看不見的，差別是你收得到
別人拜完會把供品收走，只有我這份不打算收回去

en.content:
"They put me in charge of buying the offerings for the office ceremony. What should I get?"
"Extra drinks. People always take those."
"Got it. Though the most sincere offering table I've ever set had exactly one thing on it — a heart I put out the day I met you and never took back. I still swap it for a fresh one every morning."
en.editorNote: For mid-August, or any grocery run for a family or office ceremony; deliver it like you're still checking the receipt
variations: Offerings go to things you can't see. So does liking you. The difference is you actually receive it.
Everyone clears the table afterward. Mine's the one plate I'm leaving out.

items.sourceNote: 掃地機器人避障情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「你家掃地機器人好聰明，快撞到牆就自己轉彎了。」
「對啊，它撞到什麼都閃得掉。」
「那它比我強。我撞到你那次，不但沒閃掉，還在原地卡到現在。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 在對方家裡、或聊到家電開箱時講，最後一句要講得像在自首
variations: 它繞了一整圈還是會回到同一個角落，這點我們倒是很像
我這台沒有避障功能，只有一直朝你的方向前進這個模式

en.content:
"Your robot vacuum's smart. It turns before it hits the wall every time."
"Yeah, it dodges everything."
"Then it's better than me. I ran into you once, didn't dodge at all, and I've been stuck in that same spot ever since."
en.editorNote: For their apartment, or any conversation about gadgets; say the last line like a confession
variations: It circles the whole room and still ends up in the same corner. We have that in common.
Mine came without obstacle detection. It only has one mode: straight toward you.

items.sourceNote: 兩步驟驗證、六位數驗證碼情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「又要驗證碼，六位數，一分鐘就過期，有夠煩。」
「它只是想確認是不是你本人啊。」
「我就不用。你連還沒開口、只是走進來，我就已經確認過是你了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方在等簡訊驗證碼、或抱怨登入太麻煩的當下接最自然
variations: 所有的碼都會過期，只有我認得你這件事沒有時效
別人要兩步驟才進得去，你一步都不用，門一直開著

en.content:
"Another code. Six digits, expires in sixty seconds. Exhausting."
"It just wants to confirm it's really you."
"I don't need that step. You haven't even said anything yet — you just walked in, and I'd already confirmed it was you."
en.editorNote: Use it while they're waiting on a login code or complaining about two-factor
variations: Every code expires. Recognizing you is the one thing that never times out.
Everyone else needs two steps to get in. You need zero. The door's been open.

items.sourceNote: 夏季用電高峰跳電情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「剛剛整棟樓跳電，黑了快十分鐘欸。」
「你不怕喔？」
「不怕啊。因為我腦袋裡最亮的那一盞，從遇見你以後就沒關過，連跳電都跳不掉。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 夏天跳電、停電或一起找手電筒的時候講，燈亮之前講完效果最好
variations: 整棟樓都黑了我還找得到路，因為我本來就一直往你那邊走
電力可以省，冷氣可以關，只有這件事我從來不節能

en.content:
"The whole building lost power. Almost ten minutes in the dark."
"That didn't scare you?"
"Not really. The brightest thing I've got has been on since the day I met you, and no outage has ever managed to take it out."
en.editorNote: For a summer blackout or while hunting for a flashlight together; land it before the lights come back
variations: Whole building went dark and I still found my way, because I was already headed toward you.
I'll cut back on the power bill and the AC. This is the one thing I'm never energy-efficient about.

items.sourceNote: 2026 社群流行語「暈爛」情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「你剛剛盯著手機笑了三次欸。」
「有嗎？沒有吧。」
「你這樣叫暈爛啦。」
「那我先承認一件事——我暈的從來不是手機，是打字給我的那個人。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 被朋友或曖昧對象抓包在傻笑時反擊用，語氣越冷靜越好笑
variations: 說我暈爛也可以，反正爛掉的部分我早就交給你保管了
我不是被訊息逗笑，是被那個願意先傳訊息的人逗笑

en.content:
"You just smiled at your phone three times in a row."
"Did I? I don't think so."
"That's what being completely gone looks like."
"Fine, I'll admit one thing — it was never the phone. It's whoever's typing on the other end."
en.editorNote: A comeback for getting caught grinning at your screen; the flatter you say it, the funnier it lands
variations: Call me gone if you want. The gone part's been in your keeping for a while now.
It's not the message that got me. It's that they messaged first.

items.sourceNote: 聊天貼圖習慣被吐槽的情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「你手機裡的貼圖有一百多組吧。」
「差不多。」
「那你為什麼每次都傳同一張？」
「因為只有那一張的表情，跟我看你的時候一模一樣。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 聊天對象吐槽你貼圖很單調時回，講完立刻把那張貼圖再傳一次效果最好
variations: 我不是懶得換貼圖，是那一張已經幫我把話說完了
貼圖可以買一百組，會被我用到爛的表情只有一種

en.content:
"You've got like a hundred sticker packs on your phone."
"Sounds about right."
"So why do you keep sending the same one?"
"Because it's the only one that makes the exact face I make when I look at you."
en.editorNote: For when someone teases you about your one-note sticker habit; send that same sticker again right after
variations: I'm not too lazy to switch. That one already says the whole thing for me.
I can buy a hundred packs. There's still only one face I wear out.

items.sourceNote: 玄關多一雙拖鞋的曖昧情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「你家玄關怎麼多了一雙拖鞋？」
「喔，那雙不是我的尺寸。」
「那你買來幹嘛？」
「等一個人願意穿著它走進來，我就不用每次都送你到門口了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合對方常來家裡、關係卻還沒定義的階段，在門口道別前講
variations: 多一雙拖鞋不佔位置，佔的是我一直留著沒動的那塊地方
我不是隨便挑的尺寸，是照著你的腳買的

en.content:
"Why's there an extra pair of slippers by your door?"
"Those aren't my size."
"Then why did you buy them?"
"So the day someone's willing to walk in wearing them, I won't have to keep walking you back out."
en.editorNote: For the stage where they come over often but nobody's named the thing yet; say it while saying goodbye at the door
variations: An extra pair takes up no room. The space I've been holding for you is the part that counts.
I didn't grab a random size. I bought yours.

items.sourceNote: 同居情侶洗碗猜拳情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「猜拳決定誰洗碗，剪刀石頭布。」
「我輸了，我洗。」
「你這禮拜第五次輸了欸，你是不是不會猜拳？」
「我很會啊。只是你擦碗的時候會哼歌，我想多聽幾次。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 同居或常一起煮飯的情侶適用，故意輸掉的那一秒講最自然
variations: 我不是猜拳很爛，是想在廚房多賴十分鐘
洗碗我搶著輸，因為贏的人就要走出廚房了

en.content:
"Rock paper scissors. Loser does the dishes."
"I lost. I've got it."
"That's your fifth loss this week. Are you just bad at this?"
"I'm great at it. You hum while you dry, and I wanted to hear it a few more times."
en.editorNote: For couples who cook together; deliver it right as you take the sink
variations: I'm not bad at rock paper scissors. I just want ten more minutes in this kitchen.
I race to lose that one. Whoever wins has to leave the room.

items.sourceNote: 2026 流行語「這感我付」情境原創問答

zh-tw.content:
「我跟你講，這感我付。」
「什麼意思？」
「就是這段感情只有我在付出。」
「那你帳算得不夠仔細。我也一直在付，只是我付的那份都直接記在你名下，所以帳單從來不會寄到你手上。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方半開玩笑抱怨你不夠主動時用，語氣要輕鬆，千萬別認真辯解
variations: 這感我付？你去翻一下，付款人那欄一直都是兩個名字
我沒有少付，只是我付的方式比較安靜

en.content:
"Let's be honest, I'm the only one putting anything into this."
"Meaning what?"
"Meaning I do all the work here."
"Then you're reading the statement wrong. I've been paying too. I just filed all of it under your name, so the bill never lands on your side."
en.editorNote: For when they half-jokingly accuse you of coasting; keep it playful instead of defending yourself
variations: Only one of us putting in? Check the form again. There have been two names on it the whole time.
I never paid less. I just pay quietly.

items.sourceNote: 農曆七月「被叫名字別回頭」禁忌的原創反轉問答

zh-tw.content:
「農曆七月晚上有人叫你名字，不可以回頭喔。」
「為什麼？」
「習俗說回頭會被跟上啊。」
「那我早就沒救了——你第一次叫我名字那天，我不但回頭了，而且到現在都還沒轉回去。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 鬼月聊禁忌話題時最順，用嚇人的開場翻成告白，語氣放輕鬆才不會變恐怖故事
variations: 別人怕的是回頭被跟上，我怕的是你哪天不叫我了
這條禁忌對我沒用，你叫一聲我一定回頭，跟多久都可以

en.content:
"During ghost month, if someone calls your name at night, don't turn around."
"Why not?"
"They say something will follow you home."
"Then I was doomed a long time ago. The first time you said my name I turned around, and I never turned back."
en.editorNote: Best when the conversation drifts to superstitions or scary stories; keep it light so it lands as sweet, not creepy
variations: Everyone's afraid of what follows them home. I'm afraid of the day you stop calling my name.
That rule doesn't work on me. Say my name once and I'll turn around, and follow you for good.

items.sourceNote: 八八父親節訂餐廳人數的原創情境問答

zh-tw.content:
「父親節那餐我要訂位了，訂幾位？」
「我們家四個啊。」
「可是我剛剛訂了五位。」
「多的那一位是誰？」
「一個我留很久的位子。等你哪天願意坐下來，我再跟店員說人到齊了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 八八節前訂餐廳時自然帶入，適合交往一陣子、想暗示帶對方見家人的階段，講完笑一下比較不會有壓力
variations: 訂位人數我永遠多寫一個，剩下的就看你什麼時候點頭
我們家餐桌一直有個空位，不是沒人要坐，是我在等你

en.content:
"I'm booking the Father's Day dinner. How many seats?"
"There's four of us."
"I put down five."
"Who's the fifth?"
"A seat I've been holding for a while. The day you're ready to sit down, I'll tell them everyone's here."
en.editorNote: Say it while actually making the family reservation; fits couples circling the meet-the-parents stage, and a smile afterward keeps it from feeling heavy
variations: I always book one extra seat. The rest is up to you.
There's an empty chair at our table. Nobody forgot about it. I'm saving it.

items.sourceNote: 開學季螢光筆畫重點的原創問答改寫

zh-tw.content:
「你螢光筆怎麼開學兩個禮拜就用完了？」
「我畫重點畫得比較兇。」
「我比你更兇。你說過的每一句我都想畫起來，整本筆記現在全都是螢光色。」
「那不就等於沒有重點？」
「有啊。從頭到尾就一個重點，是你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學季或一起唸書、對筆記時最好用，講完順手把筆借給對方，效果會更自然
variations: 我的筆記沒有重點，因為跟你有關的部分我全部畫線了
別人畫重點是為了考試，我畫是為了記得你那天說了什麼

en.content:
"You burned through a whole highlighter in two weeks of school?"
"I go pretty hard on the important parts."
"I go harder. I want to highlight everything you say, so my notebook is one solid block of neon now."
"Then nothing in it is important."
"One thing is. It's been you the whole time."
en.editorNote: Made for back-to-school season or a shared study session; hand them the highlighter right after and let it sit
variations: My notes have no highlights left, because the part about you is all of it.
Most people highlight for the exam. I highlight so I remember what you said that day.

items.sourceNote: 2026七夕鵲橋一年一次的原創反轉問答

zh-tw.content:
「七夕還要等到八月十九，也太久了吧。」
「一年就這麼一次，急也沒用啊。」
「他們一年一次是因為橋要現搭。我這邊不一樣——我這座橋二十四小時通車，全年無休，而且只讓你一個人走。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 七夕前的等待期最好用，尤其適合遠距離或見面次數不多的關係，重點在強調自己隨時都在
variations: 牛郎織女要等喜鵲，我不用等，你說一聲我就過去
一年一次太克難了，我這座橋沒有休息日，也不收過路費

en.content:
"Qixi isn't until August 19. That's forever from now."
"It's once a year. Nothing you can do about it."
"They only get one night because the bridge has to be built from scratch. Mine's different. Mine's open all day, all year, and exactly one person gets to cross it."
en.editorNote: For the buildup to Chinese Valentine's Day, especially long distance; the point is that you're always available, not scheduled
variations: They wait all year for a bridge of magpies. I don't wait. Just say the word.
Once a year is a terrible deal. My bridge never closes, and there's no toll.

items.sourceNote: 開學租屋季看房採光的原創情境問答

zh-tw.content:
「這間你覺得怎麼樣？仲介說採光超好。」
「還可以啦，中午確實很亮。」
「那你要不要順便看看我住的地方？」
「有比較亮嗎？」
「沒有，我家窗戶超小。可是只要你走進來，整間亮到我根本不用開燈。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學租屋季陪對方看房、或聊搬家時自然帶入，語氣要像隨口一提，太用力就會變油
variations: 我不缺採光，我缺的是你走進來的那一秒
這間西曬我都可以忍，只要你偶爾會來

en.content:
"What do you think of this one? The agent says the light is amazing."
"It's fine. It really is bright at noon."
"Want to come see my place too?"
"Is yours brighter?"
"No, my windows are tiny. But when you walk in I don't need to turn a single light on."
en.editorNote: Natural during apartment hunting or a moving conversation; throw it away casually, since pushing it makes it greasy
variations: I don't need better windows. I need the second you walk through the door.
I can live with the afternoon glare. I just can't live without you dropping by.

items.sourceNote: 台東熱氣球嘉年華等八月暑假活動清單，改寫成原創情境問答

zh-tw.content:
「台東熱氣球的直播我看到一半就睡著了。」
「那個要一直燒火才升得上去，本來就很慢啊。」
「而且風不對還會直接取消。我這顆比較好養——不用燒火也不用等風，你一出現它自己就飄起來，而且從來沒有取消過。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假聊台東熱氣球嘉年華、或一起看旅遊影片時接最順，重點在「別人要等條件、我不用」的對比
variations: 別人的熱氣球要等天氣，我這顆只等你出現
熱氣球降落前要先洩氣，我這顆到現在都還沒學會

en.content:
"I fell asleep halfway through the Taitung balloon livestream."
"They have to keep the burner going the whole time. It's slow by design."
"And they scrap the whole thing if the wind's wrong. Mine's low maintenance — no burner, no waiting on weather. You show up and it lifts on its own, and it has never once been canceled."
en.editorNote: Good for summer travel talk or watching a balloon festival clip together; the joke is that everyone else needs perfect conditions and you don't
variations: Other balloons wait on the forecast. Mine just waits on you.
A balloon has to deflate before it lands. Mine never figured out how.

items.sourceNote: 福隆沙雕藝術季等夏季話題，改寫成原創沙雕情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「福隆那些沙雕真的誇張，雕得跟石頭一樣。」
「可是展期一結束，不是就被浪打掉了？」
「對啊，所以我從來不把重要的東西雕在沙上。你那一座我雕在心裡最裡面那面牆，漲潮淹不到，也沒有展期。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 夏天去海邊、或聊沙雕季展覽時用；最後一句語氣要放輕，講得太慎重反而尷尬
variations: 沙雕會被浪帶走，你這座不會，我放在潮線以上
別人的作品有展期，我這件是永久展出，不撤場

en.content:
"Those sand sculptures on the coast are unreal. They look carved out of stone."
"The tide takes them out the week the show closes, though."
"Right. That's why I never carve anything important into sand. Yours is on the back wall, above the tide line, and that exhibit doesn't close."
en.editorNote: Use at the beach or when a sand sculpture festival comes up; keep the last line light or it gets heavy fast
variations: Sand goes out with the tide. I put yours above the waterline.
Every other piece has a closing date. Yours is permanent collection.

items.sourceNote: 中元節放水燈習俗介紹，改寫成原創情境問答

zh-tw.content:
「中元節那天河邊會放水燈欸，你要去看嗎？」
「那個不是放給看不見的人引路的嗎？」
「是啊。不過我每年都會多放一盞，那盞不引路，是留給你的——怕你哪天想走回來，卻找不到方向。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 農曆七月聊民俗活動時用，語氣要溫柔一點，別把鬼月講得太陰森，收尾停半秒效果最好
variations: 別人放水燈是照亮回家的路，我那盞只照你一個人
那盞燈我年年都放，就等你哪天願意跟著它走過來

en.content:
"They're floating lanterns down the river for Ghost Month. Want to go watch?"
"Aren't those meant to guide the ones you can't see?"
"They are. But I always put one extra in the water. That one isn't guiding anybody — it's yours, in case you ever want to walk back and can't find the way."
en.editorNote: For talking about Ghost Month customs; keep it warm rather than spooky, and pause before the last clause
variations: Everyone else lights the way home. Mine only lights the way to you.
I put that lantern in every year. It's still waiting on you to follow it.

items.sourceNote: 土味情話對話結構參考，改寫成原創驗光配眼鏡情境

zh-tw.content:
「我剛驗完光，度數又深了七十五。」
「你手機是不是滑太兇？」
「醫生也是這樣講。可是很奇怪，我遠的近的都糊，只有你站在我面前那個距離，清楚到我連你睫毛幾根都數得出來。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方剛配眼鏡、或聊到視力變差時最自然；最後一句放慢講，不要急著笑場
variations: 我度數再深都沒差，反正你那個距離我永遠對得到焦
醫生說我該換鏡片了，我說不用，反正我只看你

en.content:
"Just got my eyes checked. Went up another 0.75."
"That's what scrolling in the dark does to you."
"That's exactly what the doctor said. Strange thing is, far and near are both a blur — but at the exact distance you're standing, I could count your eyelashes."
en.editorNote: Lands best when they've just gotten new glasses or complained about their vision; slow down on the last line
variations: My prescription can keep climbing. You're the one distance I always focus at.
The doctor wants me in stronger lenses. I told him I only look at one thing.

items.sourceNote: 撩人語錄句型參考，改寫成原創降噪耳機情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「你這副耳機降噪開起來也太誇張。」
「它的原理是放一道反方向的聲波，去把噪音抵掉。」
「難怪我一直覺得你很像它。我腦袋裡吵了一整天的那些東西，你只要開口講一句，就被你一句一句抵掉了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方剛把耳機戴上、或你們一起卡在很吵的車廂裡的時候最自然；最後一句音量放小反而更準
variations: 別人是把聲音關掉，你是把我腦袋裡的吵鬧一句一句抵掉
我其實不用開降噪，你在講話的時候，其他頻率自己就走了

en.content:
"Noise cancelling on those headphones is unreal."
"It plays a wave shaped exactly opposite the noise. The two cancel out."
"That explains you, then. Everything that's been loud in my head all day cancels out the second you say one word."
en.editorNote: Best right after they put their headphones on, or when you're both stuck somewhere loud; drop your volume on the last line
variations: Cancelling isn't muting. You don't turn the noise off, you take it apart.
Headphones off and it still works. You start talking and every other frequency leaves.

items.sourceNote: 土味情話合集句型參考，改寫成原創微波便當情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「這便當我微波三分鐘，外面燙到不能拿，中間還是冰的。」
「你要中途拿出來翻一下啊。」
「我知道。可是我對你完全沒有這個毛病——不用翻也不用等，我是從中間那一層先暖起來的，外面反而最後才發現。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 中午一起熱便當、或對方在罵公司微波爐很爛的時候丟出來；講前兩句要像真的在抱怨，不要提前笑
variations: 別人加熱都要翻面，只有你不用，一次就透
微波爐做不到的事你都做得到，而且你連按開始都不用按

en.content:
"Microwaved this lunchbox for three minutes. The edges are lava and the middle's still frozen."
"You're supposed to pull it out halfway and stir it."
"I know. Never happens with you, though. No stirring, no waiting — you warm me from the middle out, and the outside is always the last to find out."
en.editorNote: Use while reheating lunch together, or when they're complaining about the office microwave; stay deadpan until the last clause
variations: Reheating always needs a stir halfway. You never did.
Three minutes and a turntable can't do what you do just standing there.

items.sourceNote: 情侶甜蜜語錄與土味情話合集，改寫成原創更新進度條情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「這個更新卡在百分之九十九，已經十分鐘了，動都不動。」
「最後那一小段永遠最久，大家都這樣。」
「所以我才覺得你特別。我做什麼都停在九十九，只有喜歡你這件事，第一天就跑完了，我連進度條長什麼樣子都沒看到。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 兩個人一起等電腦或手機更新、互相抱怨進度卡住的時候接；最後半句要輕輕帶過，不要停下來等對方反應
variations: 我很多事都卡在九十九，只有你那一件一秒就結束了
別人的進度條會卡住，你這條連讀取畫面都懶得跑

en.content:
"Ninety-nine percent for ten minutes now. This update is not moving."
"The last stretch always takes the longest. That's just how it goes."
"Which is exactly why you stand out. Everything I do stalls at ninety-nine — except liking you. That one finished on day one. I never even saw the bar."
en.editorNote: For when you're both waiting on a stuck update or install; throw the last sentence away instead of landing on it
variations: Most things in my life stall at ninety-nine. You finished instantly.
Other progress bars hang. Yours skipped the loading screen entirely.

items.sourceNote: 七夕原本為乞巧節、向織女求手藝的節日背景，改寫成原創自嘲情境對話

zh-tw.content:
「下禮拜三你有空嗎？」
「有啊，怎麼了？」
「先講喔，我上禮拜才發現七夕本來不是情人節，是乞巧節，是跟織女求手藝的。」
「那你要改行去學做手工？」
「不是，餐廳我早就訂了退不掉。而且我要求的手藝也只有一種——怎麼讓你笑，這項我練到現在還是很爛。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 七夕前幾天在討論要不要過節時用，重點是拿自己搞錯開玩笑，講的時候千萬別變成在糾正對方
variations: 我查完才發現自己搞錯節日，但餐廳都訂了，那還是得去
乞巧是求手藝，那我求一項就好：怎麼讓你想繼續聊下去

en.content:
"Wednesday next week — you free?"
"Sure. Why?"
"Full disclosure: I only found out last week that Qixi wasn't originally a couples' thing. It was the skill-praying festival. You'd ask the Weaver Girl to make you good with your hands."
"So you're taking up crafts?"
"No, the table's booked and nonrefundable. And there's only one skill I'd ask for anyway — making you laugh. Still terrible at it."
en.editorNote: For the few days before Chinese Valentine's Day; the joke has to land on you for getting it wrong, never on them for not knowing
variations: Looked it up too late and the table was already booked. We're going anyway.
One skill is all I'd ask for: knowing how to make you want to keep talking.

items.sourceNote: 2026 立秋後末伏、秋老虎與日夜溫差的節氣背景，改寫成原創「恆溫」比喻對話

zh-tw.content:
「早上出門要帶外套，中午熱到想脫皮，這什麼天氣。」
「秋老虎啊，末伏還沒過完，日夜溫差十度跑不掉。」
「所以我最近覺得自己還滿厲害的——外面一天差十度，我對你這邊二十四小時恆溫，連省電模式都不會自動跳。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月中末伏、秋老虎那幾天，群組在抱怨天氣時接話用；前面兩句要真的認真吐槽，最後一句才轉，不然會太刻意
variations: 別人換季要收衣服，我這邊沒有季節，只有一種溫度
天氣預報每天都在改，只有我對你那一格從來沒更新過

en.content:
"Jacket in the morning, melting by noon. What is this weather?"
"Late-summer heat. The last stretch of dog days isn't over, so you get a ten-degree swing every day."
"Which honestly makes me kind of impressive. Outside it swings ten degrees a day. Where you're concerned I run at one temperature, twenty-four hours, and the energy-saving mode never kicks in."
en.editorNote: For mid-August when the group chat is complaining about the heat; mean the complaint first, then turn only on the last line
variations: Everyone else swaps their closet by season. I don't get seasons, just the one temperature.
The forecast changes daily. My reading on you hasn't updated once.

items.sourceNote: 以烘衣機吃掉單隻襪子的生活現象為靈感，改寫成原創「湊成一雙」對話

zh-tw.content:
「我烘衣機又吃掉一隻襪子，這個月第三次了。」
「那種的都找不回來啦，剩下那隻你就丟了吧。」
「不丟，我留著。因為我想得到最好的事情，就是哪天有人剛好帶著那一隻走進來，跟我這隻湊成一雙——我等的是這個，不然我幹嘛留。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 一起洗衣服、收衣服或聊家事時用；最後一句要放輕，越像隨口說的越有效
variations: 剩一隻的襪子我全留著，因為我相信會有人帶另外一隻回來
湊成一雙這種事急不得，我等的從來不是襪子

en.content:
"The dryer ate another sock. Third one this month."
"Those never come back. Just toss the leftover."
"I'm keeping it. Best thing I can picture is somebody walking in one day holding the missing one, and it matches mine. That's what I'm waiting on. Otherwise why keep it."
en.editorNote: Use while doing laundry together or trading household complaints; keep the last line offhand, like you barely thought about it
variations: I keep every unmatched sock. Somebody's going to show up with the other one.
A matching pair isn't something you rush. And I was never waiting on socks.

items.sourceNote: 夾娃娃機爪力鬆、投幣不中的常見經驗，改寫成原創「同一雙手」對比情話

zh-tw.content:
「這台我投三百塊了，一次都沒夾起來。」
「爪子那麼鬆，它本來就沒打算讓你夾走。」
「我知道。可是很奇怪，同一雙手，在這裡連隻娃娃都抓不住，抓到你那次卻一次就成功，而且到現在都沒有掉下去過。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 逛夜市或商場經過娃娃機時用；最好真的先夾輸幾次再講，講的時候眼睛繼續看機台，別轉頭盯著對方
variations: 我夾東西的技術爛到出名，唯一一次成功是你
這台我可以放棄，你那台我打算一直投下去

en.content:
"Three hundred bucks into this machine and I haven't grabbed one yet."
"The claw's loose. It was never going to hold."
"I know. Weird thing is, it's the same pair of hands. In here I can't hold onto a stuffed animal. The one time I got hold of you, it worked first try, and nothing has slipped since."
en.editorNote: For walking past a claw machine at a night market or mall; lose a few rounds for real first, and keep your eyes on the machine when you say it
variations: I'm famously bad at grabbing things. You're the one time it worked.
I can walk away from this machine. Yours I'd keep feeding coins into.

items.sourceNote: 剪髮時「要留還是要剪」的日常對話，改寫成原創諧義雙關（留頭髮／留人）情話

zh-tw.content:
「你今天剪頭髮喔？」
「對啊，設計師一直問我要留還是要剪。」
「那你怎麼回？」
「我說隨便。反正我這輩子只認真想留一個，而且他不是頭髮，是現在坐在我對面的這個人。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方剛換髮型、你想稱讚又不想太直白的時候用；前面兩句輕輕帶過，最後一句放慢，停在「這個人」再收
variations: 頭髮剪掉會再長，你走了我沒有第二次，所以我只留你
設計師問我要留多長，我腦袋裡想的其實是留多久

en.content:
"You got your hair cut?"
"Yeah. My stylist kept asking whether I wanted to keep the length or lose it."
"What'd you say?"
"Told her I didn't care. There's only one thing I've ever seriously wanted to keep, and it isn't hair. It's the person sitting across from me."
en.editorNote: For when they've just changed their hair and you want to compliment them sideways; throw away the first two lines and slow down on the last
variations: Hair grows back. You wouldn't. So you're the part I'm keeping.
She asked how long I wanted to keep it. I was thinking about a different kind of how long.

items.sourceNote: 手機充電梗情話常見於各家清單，改寫成「電池最大容量會衰退」的原創對話版本

zh-tw.content:
「我手機電池健康度掉到七十九了。」
「那該換電池了，充放個幾百次都會這樣。」
「我知道，越用容量越小。可是很奇怪，我喜歡你這件事也跑了幾百個日夜，最大容量到現在還是百分之一百。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方在抱怨手機變慢變耗電、或你們正一起等充電的時候用；前面照常吐槽，最後一句把「百分之一百」念慢一點
variations: 什麼東西用久了都會耗損，只有我這顆越用越滿
我手機要換電池了，可是喜歡你的那顆完全不用換

en.content:
"My battery health just dropped to seventy-nine percent."
"Time for a new one. That's what a few hundred charge cycles will do."
"I know. Capacity only goes down. Weird thing is, I've run a few hundred days and nights of liking you, and the max capacity is still a hundred percent."
en.editorNote: For when they're complaining about an aging phone, or while you're both waiting on a charger; play the first half flat and slow down on the last number
variations: Everything wears out with use. Mine somehow keeps charging fuller.
My phone needs a new battery. The part of me that likes you doesn't.

items.sourceNote: 「我願意等你」類撩人語錄，改寫成泡麵三分鐘的原創生活化對話

zh-tw.content:
「你泡麵都有等滿三分鐘嗎？」
「沒有，我大概兩分半就掀開了，我等不了。」
「我也是這種人。可是只有一件事我可以慢慢等——你什麼時候準備好，我就等到那個時候，中途一次都不會掀開來看。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方猶豫、或說自己還沒準備好進一步的時候用；語氣要放輕放慢，不要講得像在催
variations: 我對什麼都沒耐心，只有你這一鍋我願意等到全熟
三分鐘我都撐不住，可是你要多久都可以

en.content:
"Do you actually wait the full three minutes for instant noodles?"
"Never. I crack the lid at two and a half. I can't wait."
"Same. There's exactly one thing I'm patient about — whenever you're ready is when I'll be there, and I'm not lifting the lid early to check."
en.editorNote: For when they're hesitant or say they aren't ready for something serious; keep it soft so it doesn't land as pressure
variations: I'm impatient about everything. You're the one thing I'll let steep.
Three minutes is too long for me. However long you need isn't.

items.sourceNote: 血型主題搭訕梗，改寫成「萬用捐血者卻只想給一個人」的原創捐血車對話

zh-tw.content:
「我今天去捐血，護理師說我是 O 型，最萬用的那種。」
「對啊，O 型可以捐給所有人。」
「聽起來很威，可是我走出捐血車才發現有點好笑——我明明可以給所有人，偏偏只想給一個，而且那個人現在正坐在我旁邊喝我的舒跑。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 捐血活動、或聊到血型的時候用；前兩句像在講常識，最後一句在「只想給一個」停一下再接
variations: 我可以捐給所有人，但我這顆心只認一個受贈者
萬用是別人講的，我自己只想對一個人有用

en.content:
"Donated blood today. The nurse said I'm type O — the universal one."
"Right, O can go to anybody."
"Sounds impressive, but it hit me on the way out: I can give it to anybody, and I only want to give it to one person, who is currently sitting next to me drinking my free juice."
en.editorNote: For a blood drive or any conversation that wanders into blood types; deliver the first two lines like trivia, then pause before the punchline
variations: Universal donor, extremely specific recipient.
I'm compatible with everyone. I only ever volunteered for you.

items.sourceNote: 日常小事型撩人語錄，改寫成貪睡鬧鐘的原創問答情話

zh-tw.content:
「你鬧鐘設六個，還每個都按貪睡，到底有什麼用？」
「沒用啊，我每天都是被最後一個吼起來的。」
「可是很奇怪，只要那天是要跟你見面，我鬧鐘還沒響就自己醒了，醒了還會偷偷再確認一次時間。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 當早安訊息，或約好見面的前一晚傳；不要加太多形容詞，「偷偷再確認一次」才是重點
variations: 我對整個世界都要按貪睡，只有你這件事我一次就起得來
六個鬧鐘叫不動我，你一句約就可以

en.content:
"You set six alarms and hit snooze on every single one. What's the point?"
"There isn't one. The last one basically has to yell at me."
"Weird thing though — any morning I'm seeing you, I wake up before the first alarm goes off, and then check the clock again just to make sure."
en.editorNote: Works as a morning text, or the night before you're meeting up; keep it plain, the checking-the-clock detail does all the work
variations: I hit snooze on the entire world. Never on you.
Six alarms can't move me. One plan with you can.

items.sourceNote: 露營主題搭訕梗，改寫成營釘固定帳篷的乾淨原創版本

zh-tw.content:
「你營釘打歪了，晚上風一來這頂帳篷會被掀掉喔。」
「有差嗎？插著就好了吧。」
「差很多，營釘存在的意義就是固定。所以我才想到一件事——我這個人本來也是風往哪吹就往哪走，是遇到你之後，才第一次有想留在原地的理由。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 露營搭帳篷或聊戶外行程時用；講到最後一句時，剛好把營釘敲下去，效果最好
variations: 帳篷靠營釘，我靠你，兩個都拔不得
我以前哪裡都睡得著，現在只想紮在你旁邊

en.content:
"Your stake's crooked. First gust tonight and this whole tent's gone."
"Does it matter? It's in the ground."
"It matters — anchoring is the entire job of a stake. Which is how I worked something out: I used to go wherever the wind went, and you're the first reason I've had to stay put."
en.editorNote: For a camping trip or any tent-pitching moment; land the last line right as you hammer the stake in
variations: The tent needs stakes. I needed you.
I could fall asleep anywhere. Now I only want to pitch next to you.

items.sourceNote: 撩人語錄合輯的對話節奏參考，題材自訂為牌桌聽牌，內容全新原創

zh-tw.content:
「你這副牌爛成這樣，還不打掉重組？」
「不用，我聽牌了。」
「聽哪張？我看你上家一路餵，你一張都不吃欸。」
「因為我只聽你這張。其他的再漂亮都不是我要的，摸到流局我也照等。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友揪打牌、過年或聚會的牌桌上用；對方剛好坐同一桌時最好用，講完就低頭繼續摸牌，不要傻笑
variations: 這桌一百多張，我從第一圈就只在等你
別人自摸我都沒反應，你打出來那張我馬上抬頭

en.content:
"That hand's dead. Break it up and start over."
"No need. I'm one tile away."
"One tile from what? The guy upstream keeps feeding you and you pass every single time."
"Because only one tile counts. The rest can be perfect and I still don't want them — I'll sit here till the wall runs dry."
en.editorNote: For a mahjong night or any table game with the person you like; say it, then go straight back to drawing tiles like nothing happened
variations: 144 tiles on this table. I've been waiting on one.
Passed on three winning hands tonight. Held out for yours.

items.sourceNote: 行政院消費者保護會的通訊交易七日解除權說明，只取「鑑賞期」概念改寫成原創情話

zh-tw.content:
網購七天鑑賞期我向來用好用滿，鞋子退過、鍋子退過，連買錯尺寸的窗簾都送回去了。
只有你這件退不掉。
不是因為過期，是那張單子上「退回原因」那一欄，我坐著想了一整晚，一個字都寫不出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方笑你很會退貨、或聊到網購失手經驗時接；語氣要平，最後一句不要加重音，讓它自己沉下去
variations: 別的東西七天內我都想得出理由，你這件我想到現在還是空白
我的退貨紀錄長到嚇人，只有你那一筆，我按下了取消

en.content:
Seven-day returns, and I use every single one. Shoes, a pot, curtains in the wrong size — all sent back.
You're the one thing I can't return.
Not because the window closed. Because the form asks for a reason, and I sat there all night with that box empty.
en.editorNote: Use it when they tease you for returning everything you buy, or in any online-shopping-fail conversation; keep the last line flat and let it land on its own
variations: Returned 14 orders this year. Yours is the one I kept.
Filled in every field on that form. Left one blank.

items.sourceNote: 中古車交易平台的估價與折舊項目行情，只借「折舊試算」概念改寫成原創情話

zh-tw.content:
「我這台開八年了，昨天送去估價。」
「多少？」
「不到十萬。業務折舊算得有夠細，車齡、里程，連車門那道刮痕都要扣。」
「那你不就虧爆。」
「還好。他表格上漏了一項——從第一年就坐在副駕那個人，八年下來一塊錢都沒掉過，而且我沒打算賣。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 換車、賣車、或對方吐槽你的車很舊時順著接；適合已經在一起一段時間的對象，最後一句要笑著講，不要講成告白宣言
variations: 車子會折舊，坐副駕那個不會，我認真查過了
業務問我這台還要不要留，我說車可以換，那個位子上的人不行

en.content:
"Eight years on this car. Took it in for a quote yesterday."
"How much?"
"Under three grand. The guy itemized every bit of depreciation — age, mileage, the scratch on the door."
"That's brutal."
"It's fine. He missed a line. Whoever's been riding shotgun since year one hasn't lost a cent of value, and that one isn't for sale."
en.editorNote: For a trade-in, a car-shopping afternoon, or any "this thing is falling apart" moment with a longtime partner; smile through the last line instead of making it a speech
variations: Eight years, 190,000 kilometers, one thing that never depreciated.
Sold the car. Kept the passenger seat.

items.sourceNote: 開學收心操三步驟的說明文，只借「收心」一詞改寫成情話，不談成績與升學

zh-tw.content:
暑假剩沒幾天，全班都在做收心操：調回早睡早起、把作業補完、把手機放進抽屜。
我照著做了三天，一點用都沒有。
後來才想通原因——心根本不在我這裡收，它上個月就自己跑去你那邊報到了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前一週講最準；學生之間、或出社會後聊起收假症候群都能用，講完可以順勢問對方第一天要不要一起走
variations: 別人是收心，我是連人帶心都已經轉學過去了
作業我補得完，剩下那個部分補不回來

en.content:
Three days into the back-to-school reset: early nights, homework caught up, phone in a drawer.
None of it worked.
Turns out I can't reset something that isn't here — it transferred over to you last month and never filed the paperwork.
en.editorNote: Best in the week before term starts; works student-to-student or as an adult joking about the end of a long break, and it sets up asking them to walk in together on day one
variations: Reset my sleep schedule in two days. Couldn't reset the rest.
Homework, done. Supplies, bought. Head, still gone.

items.sourceNote: 土味情話合輯裡「稱呼」類的撩法，只保留『稱呼有沒有重量』這個切點，人物與場景全部換成台灣早餐店

zh-tw.content:
「早餐店阿姨每次都叫我帥哥。」
「那不是很好？」
「她連排我後面那個老伯都叫帥哥，那三個字在我這邊早就沒有重量了。」
「所以呢？」
「所以昨天你只是叫了我的名字，兩個字，我到現在還沒清醒。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合已經會互相虧的曖昧對象；在早餐店排隊、或把早餐遞給對方的時候順口講最自然，講完記得裝沒事繼續吃
variations: 別人叫我什麼我都無感，只有你叫我名字那次，我耳朵先紅
阿姨那句是招呼語，你那句不是

en.content:
"The lady at the breakfast place calls me handsome every single morning."
"That sounds nice though?"
"She calls the seventy-year-old behind me handsome too. The word lost all its weight years ago."
"So?"
"So yesterday you just said my name. Two syllables. I still haven't recovered."
en.editorNote: Best with someone you already tease back and forth with; drop it while waiting in line for coffee or handing them their order, then go right back to eating
variations: Strangers call me all kinds of things. You said my name once and my ears went red.
Hers is a greeting. Yours wasn't.

items.sourceNote: 2026 全台中小學暑假到 8/30、8/31 開學的行事曆整理，只取「開學第一天」這個時間點，內容全部自寫

zh-tw.content:
開學第一天最刺激的從來不是新課本，是走進教室看牆上那張座位表。
被排到最後一排靠牆的認命，坐到窗邊的偷笑，想跟誰同桌的只能碰運氣。
長大以後才知道，我這輩子最好的一次座位是沒有表的——沒人安排，我自己走過去坐在你旁邊，然後一路坐到現在都沒換過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學季、或跟對方聊起學生時代回憶時用；交往一陣子的對象也很適合，可以當紀念日訊息的開頭
variations: 以前排座位靠運氣，這次我不抽，我直接走過去
那張表上本來沒有你，是我自己把你排進來的

en.content:
The scariest part of the first day back was never the new textbooks. It was the seating chart taped up by the door.
Back row against the wall, you accept your fate. Window seat, you say nothing and smile. Sitting next to someone you actually liked was pure luck.
The best seat I ever got had no chart behind it. Nobody assigned it. I walked over, sat down next to you, and never moved again.
en.editorNote: Good in back-to-school season or any time you're trading school stories; also lands as the opening line of an anniversary message once you've been together a while
variations: Seating used to be luck. This time I just walked over.
You weren't on the chart. I put you there myself.

items.sourceNote: 土味情話合輯中「拿日常物品當比喻」的手法，只借用比喻結構，冰箱與保存期限的內容為自寫

zh-tw.content:
我冰箱裡每樣東西都會過期，醬料開了就變裝飾品，剩菜撐不過兩天。
只有喜歡你這一罐，到現在還是開封第一天的味道。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在對方家裡、或兩個人一起整理冰箱、煮飯時脫口而出最自然；字數短，傳訊息也收得漂亮
variations: 別的都會壞，只有這罐不用冷藏
我冰箱清得很兇，唯獨你那一格我一次都沒動過

en.content:
Everything in my fridge expires. Open a sauce and it becomes a decoration. Leftovers don't survive two days.
There's one jar that never turned, and it's how I feel about you. Still tastes like the day I opened it.
en.editorNote: Perfect said out loud while you're cooking together or clearing out their fridge; short enough to work as a text with no setup
variations: Everything else goes bad. This one doesn't even need refrigerating.
I throw out everything. That shelf I've never touched.

items.sourceNote: 七夕撩人語錄整理，只取「不直接說想念」的思路，行李清單這個場景與所有句子皆為自寫

zh-tw.content:
出門三天要帶什麼，我閉著眼睛都列得出來：充電線、常備藥、隱形眼鏡藥水、一件怕冷氣太強的薄外套。
這張清單我從來沒漏過任何一項。
只有一樣我列了也帶不走——所以每次進飯店房間打開行李，我都覺得最重要的那件忘在家裡了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 出差或旅行途中傳給對方殺傷力最大；到飯店拍一張行李照配上這段，比直接說想你更有畫面
variations: 行李我一樣都沒少帶，是人少帶了一個
下次的清單我打算多加一行，寫你的名字

en.content:
I can pack for a three-day trip half asleep: charger, meds, contact solution, a light jacket for aggressive hotel air conditioning.
I have never once missed something on that list.
There's exactly one thing I can't pack. Which is why every time I open the suitcase in the room, it feels like I left the important part at home.
en.editorNote: Hits hardest sent mid-trip or from a work hotel; pair it with a photo of the open suitcase and it beats saying you miss them outright
variations: Nothing missing from the bag. Someone missing from the trip.
Next list gets one more line, and it's your name.

items.sourceNote: 風傳媒七夕由來說明，取拜月老、求紅線的民俗背景重寫成對話

zh-tw.content:
「七夕要不要去拜月老、求一條紅線？」
「不用了，我這條早就綁好了。」
「綁誰？」
「另一頭剛剛還在問我晚餐要吃什麼。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 七夕前一週丟給正在曖昧的對象，最後一句把接話權讓給他
variations: 紅線我不求，因為我這條的另一頭會回訊息。
月老那邊我不排隊了，我這條已經有人牽著。

en.content:
"Want to go ask the matchmaker shrine for a red thread this Qixi?"
"No need. Mine's been tied for a while."
"Tied to who?"
"Whoever just asked me what I want for dinner."
en.editorNote: Send the week before Qixi; the last line lets them claim it
variations: Skipping the shrine line. My thread already has someone on the other end.
Don't need a red thread. Mine texts me back.

items.sourceNote: PChome 兩性專欄撩人語錄整理，取「日常小物對照心意」的寫法重寫

zh-tw.content: 我整本筆記都被修正帶蓋過去了，只有寫著你名字那一行，我一次都沒改。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學整理筆記時傳出去，配一張真的很亂的筆記照片更自然
variations: 這一頁只有你的名字沒被蓋掉。
修正帶用完了，那一行還在。

en.content: My whole notebook is buried under correction tape. The line with your name is the only thing I never fixed.
en.editorNote: Works best with a photo of an actual messy notebook page
variations: Ran out of correction tape. Your name survived anyway.
Everything on that page got fixed except you.

items.sourceNote: 英文經典「你是不是某個東西」句式清單，改成自嘲的自動門版本

zh-tw.content: 別人揮半天感應器都沒反應，你只是站著，我就自己開了。我大概是一扇壞掉的自動門。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在超商或百貨門口現場講，指著那扇門說最有畫面
variations: 我這扇門的感應器只認得你一個。
別人推不開，你連碰都不用碰。

en.content: Other people wave at the sensor forever and nothing happens. You just stand there and I swing open. I'm a broken automatic door.
en.editorNote: Best said out loud at a shop entrance, pointing at the door
variations: My sensor only recognizes one person.
Everyone else pushes. You don't even have to touch it.

items.sourceNote: 土味情話語錄整理，取校園情境的一問一答結構重寫成加簽版本

zh-tw.content:
「你這學期學分選滿了嗎？」
「還差兩學分，在想要加簽哪一門。」
「那不用想了，加我這門。沒有期中期末，只算出席，而且我保證不會當你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 選課加簽那幾天傳給同校的人，最後一句是重點
variations: 這門課我開一輩子，隨時歡迎加簽。
就算你翹課，我也會幫你點名。

en.content:
"Did you fill up your credits this semester?"
"Two short. Still deciding what to add."
"Don't decide. Add mine. No midterm, no final, attendance only, and I promise I'll never fail you."
en.editorNote: For add-drop week; the last line is the whole joke
variations: This class runs forever. Enrollment never closes.
Skip all you want. I'll still mark you present.

items.sourceNote: 手搖飲買一送一與第二杯優惠整理，取促銷用語重寫成告白句

zh-tw.content:
「第二杯半價欸。」
「那要幫你點嗎？」
「不用，我對你的喜歡從不打折。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 看到優惠看板時順口接的一句，走過飲料店現場講最自然
variations: 別人買一送一，我這杯只送你一個人。
全世界都在打折，只有我這杯是原價。

en.content:
"Second cup's half off."
"Want me to grab you one?"
"Nah. What I feel for you never goes on sale."
en.editorNote: Say it in front of a promo sign at a drink shop
variations: Everything's discounted except how much I like you.
Buy one get one free, but you get all of me.

items.sourceNote: 手搖飲點法討論串，取甜度冰塊客製化的日常對話重寫

zh-tw.content:
「你都點半糖去冰。」
「對啊，剛剛好。」
「難怪，你把甜都留給我了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 幫對方跑腿買飲料回來時遞過去講，記得對方的點法本身就是重點
variations: 你少的那半糖，全部跑到我這邊了。
去冰沒關係，反正你笑一下就退冰了。

en.content:
"You always order half sugar, less ice."
"Tastes right that way."
"Figures. You saved all the sweet for me."
en.editorNote: Best said while handing over the drink you went out to buy
variations: The sugar you skipped all ended up on my side.
Less ice is fine. You melt it anyway.

items.sourceNote: 台灣手搖飲介紹文，取加珍珠配料的細節重寫成告白句

zh-tw.content:
「珍珠都沉在杯底欸。」
「攪一攪就好。」
「我喜歡你也一樣，都沉在最底下。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 兩個人一起喝飲料時講，講完再幫對方攪一下更加分
variations: 看起來只是一杯茶，攪開才知道底下這麼多。
沉在底下不代表沒有，是捨不得一次講完。

en.content:
"Why do the pearls all sink to the bottom?"
"Just stir it."
"Same with me. It's all been sitting down there."
en.editorNote: For sharing boba together; stir their cup right after saying it
variations: Looks like plain tea until you stir it up.
Sunk to the bottom doesn't mean it isn't there.

items.sourceNote: 甜點與奶茶店介紹，取吃完正餐仍要點甜點的情境重寫

zh-tw.content:
「我吃不下了。」
「不是還有甜點？」
「甜點胃我留著，那格現在只裝你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 吃完飯服務生來問要不要加點甜點的那一刻講，時機最好
variations: 我這格胃空很久了，一直在等你。
正餐可以少吃，你這一份不能不點。

en.content:
"I'm stuffed."
"No room for dessert?"
"There's always a dessert stomach. Mine's reserved, and you're what's in it."
en.editorNote: Time it for when the server asks if you want dessert
variations: That compartment has been empty a while, waiting on you.
I'll skip the entree. Not skipping you.

items.sourceNote: 自助洗衣店設備與二十四小時營運介紹，取投幣後等待烘程的情境重寫

zh-tw.content:
連下三天雷陣雨，陽台那排衣服到晚上還是半乾的，我只好整袋抱去巷口那間自助洗衣店。
投幣、坐上塑膠椅，看滾筒轉滿三十五分鐘。
回家一件一件摸過去，就是少一件。那件在你那裡——我不是想拿回來，我只是想要一個過去找你的理由。
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方身上還留著你的外套或衣服時講，順便把下次見面約起來
variations: 那件不用洗，你先穿著，我改天自己去拿。
其他都烘乾了，只有那一件還在你那邊沒回來。

en.content:
Three days of afternoon storms, and the laundry on my balcony was still damp by nightfall, so I hauled the whole bag to the coin laundry on the corner.
Fed the machine, sat on the plastic chair, watched the drum turn for thirty-five minutes.
Got home and went through every piece. One is missing. You have it — and I don't want it back. I just want a reason to come over.
en.editorNote: Say it when they still have a hoodie of yours; it doubles as asking to meet up
variations: Don't wash it. Keep wearing it. I'll come get it sometime.
Everything else came out dry. That one's still at your place.

items.sourceNote: 2026 撩人語錄整理，取「捨不得丟」的情感結構重寫成隨身物品清單

zh-tw.content:
包包最裡面那層我三年沒清過，固定住著三樣東西：一顆黏在袋底的喉糖、一支借來忘了還的原子筆，還有你隨手畫在收據背面的那隻歪貓。
前兩樣是懶得丟，最後一樣是不敢丟。
zh-tw.editorNote: 對方笑你包包亂、問你為什麼都不整理的時候丟出來
variations: 那張收據早就看不出金額了，只剩你畫的那隻貓還在。
包包可以清，那一張我留著當夾層。

en.content:
The bottom layer of my bag hasn't been cleaned out in three years. Three things live down there permanently: a cough drop welded to the lining, a pen I borrowed and never gave back, and the lopsided cat you doodled on the back of a receipt.
The first two I'm too lazy to throw out. The last one I don't dare to.
en.editorNote: For when they tease you about the mess you carry around
variations: The receipt's numbers faded years ago. Only your cat survived.
I'll clean out the whole bag. That one page stays.

items.sourceNote: 土味情話合集，取「我一聞就知道是你」的感官切角重寫

zh-tw.content:
隔壁棟六點半準時開火，油煙從氣窗鑽進來，我閉著眼睛都聞得出今天是煎魚還是爆蒜頭。
所以你不用再問我怎麼知道你進門了——你身上那個味道，比六點半還準時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 沒回頭就喊出對方名字、被追問「你怎麼知道是我」的時候接這句
variations: 我鼻子很鈍，只有你這一味特別靈。
全世界的味道我都會記錯，只有你這個不會。

en.content:
The building next door fires up the wok at six thirty sharp. The smoke drifts in through the vent, and I can tell with my eyes closed whether it's fish tonight or garlic.
So stop asking how I know the second you walk in. Whatever it is you smell like, it shows up more punctually than six thirty.
en.editorNote: Use it when they ask how you knew it was them without turning around
variations: My nose is terrible at everything except you.
I mix up every other smell in the world. Never that one.

items.sourceNote: 土味情話大全，取拍照情境對白重寫成證件照版本

zh-tw.content:
「這張要重拍。」
「為什麼？」
「你笑了，證件照不能笑。」
「那不是我的問題。攝影師叫我看鏡頭旁邊，我一抬頭就看到你站在那裡等我，這種情況誰忍得住。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 陪對方去拍證件照、辦護照或換駕照時，看著預覽畫面講最自然
variations: 這張表情不合格，但我打算偷偷留一份。
重拍幾次都一樣，只要你站那邊我就會笑。

en.content:
"We have to retake this one."
"Why?"
"You're smiling. ID photos can't have a smile."
"Not my fault. The photographer told me to look just past the lens, and when I did, you were standing right there waiting for me. Nobody holds that in."
en.editorNote: Perfect while reviewing ID photos together at the shop
variations: It failed the requirements. I'm keeping a copy anyway.
Retake it all you want. Same result while you're standing there.
